description: This Java class provides utility functions for handling notes in an Android application, including text processing, excerpt generation, title extraction, and font size preferences.

classes.name: NoteUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for note content processing, title generation, and user preferences handling in an Android note-taking app.

methods.name: isEmptyLine
methods.description: Checks if a given line is considered empty after markdown removal and trimming.

methods.name: truncateString
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified maximum length without throwing exceptions if the length exceeds the string size.

methods.name: generateNoteExcerpt
methods.description: Creates a text excerpt from note content, optionally excluding the title if it matches the start.

methods.name: generateNonEmptyNoteTitle
methods.description: Generates a note title from content, defaulting to a localized 'create' string if the content yields an empty title.

methods.name: generateNoteTitle
methods.description: Extracts the first non-empty line from content as the note's title.

methods.name: getLineWithoutMarkdown
methods.description: Retrieves a specific line from content, removing markdown and skipping empty lines.

methods.name: extendCategory
methods.description: Replaces slashes in category strings with spaced slashes for better readability.

methods.name: getFontSizeFromPreferences
methods.description: Determines the font size based on user preferences stored in SharedPreferences.
